purpose: The card token vault tokenizes primary account numbers (PANs) for the payment services and is the only component in the estate that stores them.

components.name: tokenization-service
components.evidence: exposes tokenize (PAN to token) and detokenize (token to PAN) to payment services.

components.name: vault-db
components.evidence: stores card records in encrypted form together with the token mapping.

components.name: Vault and KMS
components.evidence: the secret store and the key service used by the tokenization-service.

components.name: vault private subnet
components.evidence: the network boundary around the service and its database.

flows.evidence: a payment service submits a PAN; the service encrypts it, stores it, and returns a token.
the tokenization-service reads and writes card records in vault-db
a payment service submits a token and a purpose code; the service checks the purpose, decrypts the card record and returns the PAN.
each detokenize call produces an audit record with the caller, the purpose and the token.
